See without eyes.name: See without eyes
See without eyes.special: If cannot see opponent, penalites are reduced to -2 melee. Gain full defensive modifer against their attacks. Rear/Side bonus against while in theis stance. Ignores distortion spell effects. Does not apply if target is silenced.

Flow as water.name: Flow as water
Flow as water.special: -8 Defensive modifier. Dodge, Feint and Sidestep are +50%. Offensive actions are -1 to hit.

Strike as wind.name: Strike as wind
Strike as wind.special: +4 Melee/Missile to hit, Starting weapon speeds are -2 seconds. Initiative is -4, Critical, Focused Attack, Perfect Shot are +50%.

Calm in the storm.name: Calm in the storm
Calm in the storm.special: +50% resistances effects which hold or affect movement. +20% Control Resistance. Parries, Disarm and Trap Weapon are +25%, AGL Saves are +40%.

Drunken fighting.name: Drunken fighting
Drunken fighting.special: +4 to hit and +2 per die of damage after failing 1 VIT Save for intoxication. +20% to combat skills and Martial Knowledge attacks. If more than 5 VIT Saves for intoxication all modifers are lost.
